description: WANDa health check 1.0: stand-alone intake gate run on a delivery as received (after the converter, before any app import). Models in the newest models set vs the newest WANDa GIS set (wanda_network_v1): names, pipe coverage and isolation valve settings only - no PLDR, trace or flow. Proposes a per-model intake outcome for a WRc engineer to review; facts and FID lists for the PLDR map module later. Written only by wanda_import health.

container.set_name: derived\health\<YYYY-MM-DD>_health (one set a day; a same-day rerun supersedes)

fields.prev_set: previous health set compared / carried from (null = none)
fields.gis: GIS counts: pipes, DMA pipes, real DMAs, isolation valves, blank dma_ref valves placed by polygon / not placed
fields.models: [{model_name, file, size, mtime, name_ok (wanda_names rule), status, checked_at, carried (true = rows copied from prev_set)}]
models set name (wanda_client check reports STALE on a newer one of either)

flag_rules._note: defaults in wanda_import health.py, recorded per set; tune from WI / client runs
flag_rules.names_checked_min_pct: model pipe names that are GIS FIDs below this % -> names_checked no (50)
flag_rules.modelled_min_length_pct: coverage modelled at or above this % of in-network DMA length (50)
flag_rules.missing_length_max_pct: gis_pipes_missing when missing_length_m is over this % of gis_length_m (5)
flag_rules.valve_shut_below: model InitialPosition below this = shut (0.01; 0..1 scale)
flag_rules.needs_new_model_share: null = off: the tool never proposes needs_new_model (pending James)

rules: GIS: in network = status code attribute in_network (blank = in network); isolation valve = valve_type attribute isolates (blank = isolates); shut = normal_position closed, open = open, throttled / unknown / blank = not compared; real DMA = dma_areas area_type attribute is_dma.
A valve with a blank dma_ref is placed in the DMA polygon holding its point (shapely); outside every DMA = not counted.
A DMA row exists from one in-network GIS pipe of the DMA in the model. Edge DMAs get facts, never the flag.
names_checked no: only the model row (pipe / valve counts); no DMA rows; proposed engineer_review.
new_gis: every model of the newest models set checked; new_model: the named models checked, every other model's rows carried from prev_set (each keeps checked_at).
change compares a checked model's rows with prev_set by model_name + dma_ref; carried rows are copied as they were.
dma_items lists FIDs for modelled DMAs only (valves differing, pipes missing).
Only FIDs, DMA refs and model names are written; customer counts / extra never read; GIS is never changed.

types.code: a code from the field's code list

reader_rules: read by header name, ignore unknown columns (later columns are appended)
warning only: never refuse, score or plan on it

model_health.description: One row per model (checked or carried).

fields.name: model_name
fields.description: Model name = the .mdb file stem in the models set (names are the control)

fields.name: models_set
fields.description: The models set the model was read from

fields.name: gis_set
fields.description: The GIS set the model was checked against

fields.name: checked_at
fields.description: When this model was checked (a model carried from the previous set keeps its own; blank = not checked yet)

fields.name: status
fields.description: ok | skipped: <reason> (unreadable model; not checked yet)

fields.name: names_checked
fields.description: yes = at least names_checked_min_pct of the model pipe names are GIS pipe FIDs (FID_n counts); no = not checked (DMA facts blank, no DMA rows); blank = skipped

fields.name: model_pipes
fields.description: Model pipe names read (ElementNameIdMap x WaterPipe)

fields.name: model_pipes_in_gis
fields.description: Of those, names that are a GIS pipe_ref, or FID_n of one (not refused by the element description)

fields.name: model_valves
fields.description: Model isolation valves (equation VL)

fields.name: model_valves_in_gis
fields.description: Of those, names that are a GIS valve_ref

fields.name: dmas_modelled
fields.description: DMA rows with coverage modelled

fields.name: dmas_edge
fields.description: DMA rows with coverage edge

fields.name: dmas_flagged
fields.description: Modelled DMA rows with config_differs = yes

fields.name: proposed_outcome
fields.description: Proposed intake outcome (the tool proposes, the engineer decides)

fields.name: outcome_reasons
fields.description: Why (plain text, ';' separated)

dma_health.description: One row per model + GIS DMA in the model.

fields.name: model_name
fields.description: Model name (model_health.model_name)

fields.name: dma_ref
fields.description: GIS DMA reference (dma_areas, area_type is_dma)

fields.name: coverage
fields.description: modelled / edge (blank on a gone row)

fields.name: gis_pipes
fields.description: In-network GIS pipes in the DMA

fields.name: gis_length_m
fields.description: Their length (m)

fields.name: gis_pipes_in_model
fields.description: Of those, named in the model (FID or FID_n)

fields.name: length_in_model_pct
fields.description: Share of gis_length_m in the model (%; by pipe count when the GIS holds no lengths)

fields.name: missing_pipes
fields.description: In-network GIS pipes of the DMA not in the model

fields.name: missing_length_m
fields.description: Their length (m)

fields.name: valves_gis_shut
fields.description: In-network GIS isolation valves in the DMA shut in the GIS (normal_position closed)

fields.name: valves_gis_open
fields.description: ... open in the GIS (normal_position open)

fields.name: valves_in_model
fields.description: GIS isolation valves of the DMA named as a model isolation valve (VL)

fields.name: valves_differ
fields.description: Of those, a definite disagreement: GIS closed + model InitialPosition >= 0.01, or GIS open + model < 0.01

fields.name: valves_not_compared
fields.description: Of those, not compared: GIS throttled / unknown / blank, or model setting NULL

fields.name: config_differs
fields.description: The one 1.0 flag 'DMA configuration differs from GIS': yes / no; blank = not checked (edge DMA, gone row)

fields.name: flag_reasons
fields.description: valve_state_differs; gis_pipes_missing (missing_length_m over flag_rules.missing_length_max_pct of gis_length_m)

fields.name: band
fields.description: BLANK in 1.0: the place for the DMA suitability bands set later

fields.name: prev_set
fields.description: The previous health set this row was compared with (blank = none)

fields.name: change
fields.description: Against prev_set: new / same / changed / gone

fields.name: changed_fields
fields.description: Fields that changed (change = changed)

dma_items.description: One row per GIS element behind a modelled DMA's facts (for the PLDR map module).

fields.name: model_name
fields.description: Model name

fields.name: dma_ref
fields.description: GIS DMA reference

fields.name: item
fields.description: What GIS element the row is about: valve / pipe (later module rules pick items by element)

fields.name: fid
fields.description: The GIS FID (valve_ref / pipe_ref)

fields.name: issue
fields.description: gis_shut_model_open / gis_open_model_shut (valve) / missing_from_model (pipe)

fields.name: gis_value
fields.description: valve: GIS normal_position; pipe: GIS length_m

fields.name: model_value
fields.description: valve: model InitialPosition; pipe: blank
